LanguageData.TM_MagicyteAsteroid.label: magicyte-rich asteroid
LanguageData.TM_MagicyteAsteroid.description: A vacstone asteroid containing unusually rich pockets of magicyte. Its crystals can be mined for raw magicyte and occasionally yield an enchantment gem.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a gravship.
